Lock Testnet OUSD (Tempo faucet, no real value) in the vault and mint xMXN, a synthetic peso, against it. Every xMXN in circulation is debt from an over-collateralized position like this one.

What if the peso gets stronger?
Your collateral is in dollars and your debt is in pesos. When the peso strengthens, each dollar covers fewer pesos and your ratio falls.
